transcript: I found the best no chill sugar cookie cut out recipe in the entire world. Sugar cookie recipe I use is from in Katrina's kitchen. It's literally called best sugar cookie recipe and it does live up to those standards. I've been making these cookies for three years and they are as easy as they are delicious. First thing you're going to do is take two sticks of unsalted butter at room temperature and throw them into your stand mixer bowl and then add one cup of sugar on this. We are going to beat this until it is smooth for around three minutes. While my sugar and butter are creaming together, I will be adding all my dry ingredients to a bowl now. Three cups of flour, half a teaspoon of salt, as well as two teaspoons of baking powder. My sugar and butter are now creamed together. All my dry ingredients are also whisked together. I'm now going to be adding one teaspoon of vanilla extract to our cream and sugar mixture as well as a half a teaspoon of almond extract. If you don't like almond, just admit this. Don't use it. You're good. As well as one egg, mix that all in. Then we'll slowly start to combine our dry ingredients. Now that the egg and extracts are fully combined into our wet mixture, I'm now going to be slowly incorporating our dry mixture and that this should all come together into a nice ball that's pulling from the sides. And if it's not for you and still crumbly, just keep mixing it and it will come together. And here we have the finished dough. What I'm going to do is I am going to put it all together in a ball and then split that into two. And I'm going to clean my surface so wipe it down really good. And then I'm going to start rolling this out to cut out our shapes. Here's half of our sugar cookie dough. I went ahead and floured our surface after I cleaned it. I want to go ahead and roll this out to about a quarter inch thick. And then that's when I'm going to go ahead and take all my cookie cutters and start cutting out our shapes at this time. I just started preheating our oven to 350 degrees because by the time I cut out all of our shapes, it'll be preheated. I'm now going to throw these into my 350 degree oven for six to eight minutes. My cookies are now out of the oven. It took my oven eight minutes to cook these through. I will be using royal icing to decorate all these. I will share that in another video, but let me know if these are the best sugar cookies ever to you.
